title: Two clocks, one start
alt: Two aligned paths share one declared start. Funds become usable before one specified loss hardens, but after an earlier housing loss. Acknowledgement is a distinct earlier event. An unsupported clock remains UNKNOWN.

title: Who draws the map?
alt: An institution selects an account comparing evening opening hours with the current timetable. Outside its selected account, a visitor faces a missed last bus. A labelled evidence and challenge route leads to an authorised reviewer; it does not predetermine the response.

title: Growing room
alt: Three illustrative panels revisit a child, a glass and a planted pot by a window. First the child notices conditions; then an adult helps the child practise with a tray; finally the child tries another plant while help and tools remain available. Learning is possible, not guaranteed, and continuing upkeep has people behind it.
